resources.string:
This app automatically cleans Instagram links by removing known and rotating privacy trackers (such as igsh, igshid, igsi, stkn, dlrf, psln, and cplk).

• When opening links: it cleans them before opening
• When sharing text: it cleans them before sending

If no trackers are found, the app lets you know before opening the link.

If cleaning fails, the link is blocked on the first attempt to protect your privacy. Tap it again to open the original link anyway.
You will be asked every time
ℹ️ No known trackers were found.
⚠️ Could not clean the link. Opening the original link…
🚫 Error while cleaning the link. Blocked for safety.\nTap again to open it anyway.
Preferred app not found. Please choose another one.
No Instagram app found. Opening in the browser.
